group.passage:
In many countries, walking through a private forest or putting up a tent on someone else's land without permission could get you into trouble. In Sweden and Finland, however, such activities are not only allowed but [[1]] by long tradition. Under a custom often called "everyone's right," people may walk, ski, or cycle across most private land, pick wild berries and mushrooms, and even camp there for a night or two.
The custom is often traced back to a time when villages were far apart and travelers on long journeys had little choice but [[2]] other people's land. Over the centuries, it became so deeply rooted that in Sweden it is even [[3]] the constitution. For many Swedes and Finns, it is also a source of national pride, a sign that nature belongs to everyone rather than to a lucky few.
[[4]], this freedom comes with responsibilities, and visitors are expected to treat the land as carefully as its owners would. They must keep a fair distance from people's homes, close any gates they open, and take their rubbish away with them. The rule is often [[5]] in a few simple words: do not disturb, do not destroy.

tags.key_phrase: have little choice but to V（不得不……）
of course（當然；引出理所當然的但書）

1.explanation_zh: back 當動詞是「支持」，be backed by long tradition 就是「有長久的傳統支持」。not only A but B 的 B 要比 A 更進一步：這些活動在瑞典和芬蘭不只「被允許」，還「受到長久傳統的支持」。第二段也說這項習俗根深柢固，在瑞典甚至寫進了憲法。
evidence: In Sweden and Finland, however, such activities are not only allowed but [[1]] by long tradition.
Over the centuries, it became so deeply rooted

option_notes_zh.A: 【強誘答・LF】not only allowed but required（不只允許，還規定必須）是常見說法，看起來也是「更進一步」；但沒有人「必須」在別人的森林裡散步或露營，下文說的都是人人「可以」做的事。
option_notes_zh.C: limited（受到限制）和 not only … but 要求的「更進一步」方向相反，也不符合 however 所強調「和其他國家不同、更自由」。
option_notes_zh.D: discouraged（不被鼓勵）和 allowed 以及第二段的「國家驕傲」矛盾。

1.strategy_zh: 先看 however：瑞典、芬蘭和第一句「會惹上麻煩」的國家相反；再看 not only allowed but ___：要選比「允許」更進一步、又合乎事實的正面說法。backed（受支持）是 back 的動詞用法。線索在本句與第二段。
hints: however 表示瑞典、芬蘭和第一句說的國家一樣還是不同？
not only allowed but ___：空格要比「允許」更進一步，還是相反？
第二段說這項習俗在瑞典受到什麼樣的保障？

2.explanation_zh: have (little / no) choice but to V 是「除了……之外別無選擇、不得不……」，but 後面要接不定詞。村莊彼此相隔很遠，長途旅行的人幾乎只能穿越別人的土地，所以填 to cross。
evidence: The custom is often traced back to a time when villages were far apart and travelers on long journeys had little choice but [[2]] other people's land.

option_notes_zh.A: but 在這個句型裡不接動名詞 crossing。
option_notes_zh.B: 過去式或過去分詞 crossed 不能放在 but 後面表示「別無選擇只能做的事」。
option_notes_zh.D: 【強誘答・GN】cross（原形）：cannot but＋原形動詞（不得不）的 but 後面接原形，很容易混淆；但 choice but 後面要接 to V。

2.strategy_zh: 記住句型 have no choice but to V／have little choice but to V，別和 cannot but＋原形動詞混在一起。線索在本句。
hints: 空格前是 had little choice but，這是哪一個固定句型？
choice but 後面接原形、to V，還是 V-ing？
和 cannot but＋原形動詞比較一下。

3.explanation_zh: be written into（a law / the constitution）是「被明文寫進（法律、憲法）」。so deeply rooted that … 說明這項習俗根深柢固到什麼程度，even（甚至）表示更進一步：在瑞典，它甚至被寫進了憲法。下一句也說它是國家的驕傲。
evidence: Over the centuries, it became so deeply rooted that in Sweden it is even [[3]] the constitution.
For many Swedes and Finns, it is also a source of national pride

option_notes_zh.B: be written off 是「被一筆勾銷、被認為沒有價值」，而且後面不能直接接 the constitution。
option_notes_zh.C: be left out of 是「被排除在……之外」，和「根深柢固」以及 even 的加強語氣矛盾。
option_notes_zh.D: 【強誘答・LR】written out of 也是 write 的片語，但意思是「從……中被刪除」，方向和 into 相反，與 so deeply rooted（根深柢固）和 even 的加強語氣不合。

3.strategy_zh: so … that 的結果要和「根深柢固」一致，even 表示「甚至到了……的程度」，所以要選「寫進憲法」。注意 into（進入）和 out of（移出）的方向。線索在本句與下一句。
hints: so deeply rooted that … 的結果應該是更受保障，還是被拿掉？
even 表示程度加強還是減弱？
注意 into 和 out of 的方向。

4.explanation_zh: Of course 在這裡表示讓步「當然」，引出理所當然的但書。前兩段都在說這項權利多麼自由、多麼受重視；這一句轉而說「當然，這份自由也伴隨著責任」，下一句接著列出訪客必須遵守的規矩。
evidence: For many Swedes and Finns, it is also a source of national pride, a sign that nature belongs to everyone rather than to a lucky few.
[[4]], this freedom comes with responsibilities, and visitors are expected to treat the land as carefully as its owners would.

option_notes_zh.A: At last 是「終於」，表示等待之後才實現，與前後文沒有時間上的關係。
option_notes_zh.B: 【強誘答・LR】In a word 是「總而言之、一言以蔽之」，最後一段的開頭很容易讓人以為要總結；但這一句沒有把前文濃縮成一句話，而是從「自由與驕傲」轉到「責任與限制」，是先承認、再補上但書的讓步。
option_notes_zh.C: For example：這一句不是前文「國家驕傲」的例子。

4.strategy_zh: 前文都在講自由與驕傲，這句開始講責任與限制；要選能引出「理所當然的但書」的轉承語，排除「總結」、「舉例」、「時間」的關係。線索在前一段與本句。
hints: 前兩段都在講這項權利的哪一面？這一句改談什麼？
這句是在總結前文、舉例，還是承認「當然也有限制」？
要選表示「當然（引出但書）」的轉承語。

5.explanation_zh: sum up 是「總結、概括」。前一句列出訪客要遵守的規矩：和住家保持距離、隨手關上柵門、把垃圾帶走；這些規矩常被概括成冒號後幾個簡單的字：不打擾、不破壞。
evidence: They must keep a fair distance from people's homes, close any gates they open, and take their rubbish away with them.
The rule is often [[5]] in a few simple words: do not disturb, do not destroy.

option_notes_zh.A: 【強誘答・CN】made up 也是「動詞＋up」，但 make up 是「編造、組成」；「規則常被編造成幾個字」語意不通，冒號後是把前一句的規矩濃縮成一句話。
option_notes_zh.C: be given up 是「被放棄」，和「訪客應遵守」的規矩相反。
option_notes_zh.D: be taken up 是「被占用、被開始從事」，語意不通。

5.strategy_zh: in a few simple words 和冒號後的簡短口號，表示把前一句一長串規矩「濃縮、概括」起來。分辨 sum up、make up、give up、take up。線索在本句與前一句。
hints: 前一句列了哪幾條規矩？
冒號後的「不打擾、不破壞」和前一句是什麼關係？
要選表示「總結、概括」的片語。

translation_zh.text:
在許多國家，沒有事先取得同意就走進私人森林，或在別人的土地上搭帳篷，可能會惹上麻煩。然而在瑞典和芬蘭，這些活動不但被允許，還有長久的傳統支持。根據一項常被稱為「每人通行權」的習俗，人們可以在大部分私人土地上步行、滑雪或騎腳踏車，採集野生莓果和蕈菇，甚至在那裡露營一、兩個晚上。
這項習俗常被追溯到村莊彼此相距遙遠的年代，當時長途旅行的人除了穿越別人的土地之外，幾乎別無選擇。幾個世紀下來，它變得根深柢固，在瑞典甚至被寫進了憲法。對許多瑞典人和芬蘭人來說，它也是國家的驕傲，象徵大自然屬於每一個人，而不只屬於少數幸運的人。
當然，這份自由也伴隨著責任，訪客應該像土地的主人一樣小心對待這片土地。他們必須和別人的住家保持適當距離、隨手關上打開的柵門，並把垃圾帶走。這項規則常被概括成幾個簡單的字：不打擾，不破壞。

evidence: In Sweden and Finland, however, such activities are not only allowed but [[1]] by long tradition.
1.explanation_zh: not only allowed but... 遞進，「受到長久傳統支持」：backed by tradition；required 太過（並非必須做），limited、discouraged 與遞進方向相反。

evidence: travelers on long journeys had little choice but [[2]] other people's land.
2.explanation_zh: have little/no choice but to V 為固定句型，故用 to cross。

evidence: Over the centuries, it became so deeply rooted that in Sweden it is even [[3]] the constitution.
3.explanation_zh: so deeply rooted 表示根深蒂固到甚至「被寫入」憲法：written into；left out of、written out of 意思相反。

evidence: [[4]], this freedom comes with responsibilities, and visitors are expected to treat the land as carefully as its owners would.
4.explanation_zh: 先肯定前文的自由，再提醒其伴隨責任，Of course（當然，…）表讓步補充；At last、In a word、For example 邏輯不合。

evidence: The rule is often [[5]] in a few simple words: do not disturb, do not destroy.
5.explanation_zh: in a few simple words 加上冒號後的簡短口號，表示「被概括、總結為」：summed up。

evidence: In Sweden and Finland, however, such activities are not only allowed but [[1]] by long tradition.
1.explanation_zh: not only allowed but backed by long tradition：不僅被允許，還受到傳統「支持」；required 與事實不符。

evidence: The custom is often traced back to a time when villages were far apart and travelers on long journeys had little choice but [[2]] other people's land.
2.explanation_zh: had little choice but to V（除了…別無選擇），故用 to cross。

evidence: Over the centuries, it became so deeply rooted that in Sweden it is even [[3]] the constitution.
3.explanation_zh: 「被寫入憲法」為 be written into the constitution。

evidence: [[4]], this freedom comes with responsibilities, and visitors are expected to treat the land as carefully as its owners would.
4.explanation_zh: 承認自由之後當然附帶責任，Of course 表示讓步，銜接前後文。

evidence: The rule is often [[5]] in a few simple words: do not disturb, do not destroy.
5.explanation_zh: 規則常被「概括」(summed up) 為幾個簡單的字。

A.evidence: people may walk, ski, or cycle across most private land
A.explanation_zh: required 表示「規定必須」；但下文用 may 說明人們「可以」散步、滑雪、露營，沒有人被規定必須在別人土地上做這些事。

C.evidence: such activities are not only allowed but [[1]] by long tradition
C.explanation_zh: not only A but B 的 B 要比 A 更進一步，limited（受限制）與 allowed 方向相反，不是更進一步。

D.evidence: For many Swedes and Finns, it is also a source of national pride
D.explanation_zh: discouraged（不被鼓勵）與 allowed 及下文「國家的驕傲」矛盾。

A.evidence: travelers on long journeys had little choice but [[2]] other people's land
A.explanation_zh: have little choice but 後面要接不定詞 to V，不接動名詞。

B.evidence: travelers on long journeys had little choice but [[2]] other people's land
B.explanation_zh: have little choice but 後面要接不定詞 to V，過去式或過去分詞 crossed 不合語法。

D.evidence: travelers on long journeys had little choice but [[2]] other people's land
D.explanation_zh: 接原形動詞的是 cannot but V 或 do nothing but V；名詞 choice 後的 but 要接 to V（have little choice but to cross）。

B.evidence: in Sweden it is even [[3]] the constitution
B.explanation_zh: be written off 是「被一筆勾銷」，後面不能直接接 the constitution，語意也與根深柢固相反。

C.evidence: it became so deeply rooted that in Sweden it is even [[3]] the constitution
C.explanation_zh: left out of（被排除在外）與 so deeply rooted 以及 even 的加強語氣矛盾。

D.evidence: it became so deeply rooted that in Sweden it is even [[3]] the constitution
D.explanation_zh: written out of 是「從……中被刪除」，與 so deeply rooted 以及 even 的加強語氣矛盾。

A.explanation_zh: At last 是「終於」，表示等待之後才實現；前後文沒有時間先後，這裡是對前述自由補上但書。

B.evidence: [[4]], this freedom comes with responsibilities, and visitors are expected to treat the land as carefully as its owners would.
B.explanation_zh: In a word 是把前文濃縮成一句話；本句不是總結前兩段（自由與驕傲），而是轉到責任與限制，屬於先承認再補但書的讓步。

C.evidence: a sign that nature belongs to everyone rather than to a lucky few
C.explanation_zh: For example 要舉前文的例子；「這份自由伴隨著責任」不是「自然屬於每個人」的例子。

A.evidence: The rule is often [[5]] in a few simple words: do not disturb, do not destroy.
A.explanation_zh: make up 是「編造、組成」，「組成」要說 be made up of；be made up in a few words 不成立，冒號後是把前一句的規矩濃縮成幾個字，要用 sum up。

C.evidence: visitors are expected to treat the land as carefully as its owners would
C.explanation_zh: be given up 是「被放棄」，與訪客「應遵守」的規矩相反。

D.evidence: The rule is often [[5]] in a few simple words
D.explanation_zh: be taken up 是「被占用、被開始從事」，「規則常被幾個字占用」語意不通。
